<!--
Helper .qmd file that is called in index.qmd with a package name as input
and produces the same layout and output types for all tabs.
-->

```{r}
all_stats <- universe::universe_one_package("palaeoverse", pkg)

n_downloads <- get_number_of_downloads(pkg)
n_stars <- all_stats[["_stars"]]
n_forks <- get_number_of_forks(pkg)
n_prs <- get_number_of_prs(pkg, state = "all")
n_citations <- get_number_of_citations(pkg)
n_revdep <- get_number_of_revdep(pkg)
n_contributors <- length(all_stats[["_contributors"]])
last_release <- get_last_release_info(pkg)
```


### Column {.tabset}

#### Activity

##### Column

###### Row

```{r}
value_box(
  title = "Number of contributors",
  showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("people"),
  fill = TRUE,
  theme = "primary",
  value = n_contributors
)
```

```{r}
value_box(
  title = "Number of forks",
  fill = TRUE,
  theme = "primary",
  showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("diagram-2"),
  value = n_forks
)
```

```{r}
value_box(
  title = "Number of pull requests",
  fill = TRUE,
  theme = "primary",
  showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("git"),
  value = n_prs
)
```

```{r}
value_box(
  title = "Weeks since last CRAN update",
  fill = TRUE,
  theme = "primary",
  showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("arrow-counterclockwise"),
  value = last_release[["n_weeks_last_release"]]
)
```

###### Row

```{r}
n_commits <- readRDS("data/commits.rds")
n_commits <- n_commits |> filter(pkg == .env$pkg)

n_commits |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = cumul, name = "Cumulative number") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Cumulative number of commits")
```


```{r}
n_loc <- readRDS("data/git_history.rds")
n_loc <- n_loc |> filter(pkg == .env$pkg)

n_loc |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = loc, name = "Number of lines of code") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Number of lines of code")
```


#### Code quality

###### Row

```{r}
code_cov <- get_coverage_time_series(pkg)

code_cov |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = coverage, name = "Code coverage") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Code coverage")
```

```{r}
cyclocomp <- readRDS("data/git_history.rds")
cyclocomp <- cyclocomp |> filter(pkg == .env$pkg)

cyclocomp |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = mean_cyclocomp, name = "Average cyclomatic complexity") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Average cyclomatic complexity")
```


###### Row

```{r}
cov_by_file <- get_coverage_by_file(pkg)

cov_by_file |>
  reactable(
    columns = list(
      file = colDef(name = "File"),
      coverage = colDef(
        name = "Coverage (%)",
        format = colFormat(digits = 1)
      ),
      lines = colDef(name = "Lines"),
      hits = colDef(name = "Hits"),
      misses = colDef(name = "Misses")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(coverage = "asc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
cyclocomp_by_function <- get_cyclocomp_by_function(pkg)

cyclocomp_by_function |>
  reactable(
    columns = list(
      function_name = colDef(name = "Function"),
      complexity = colDef(name = "Cyclomatic complexity")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(complexity = "desc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
```

###### Row

```{r}
cran_dl <- get_number_of_downloads_time_series(pkg)

cran_dl |>
  filter(
    (as.numeric(gsub("\\d{4}-\\d{2}-(\\d{2})", "\\1", date)) %% 7) == 0
  ) |>
  e_charts(x = date) |>
  e_line(serie = cumul, name = "Cumulative number") |>
  e_legend(show = FALSE) |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |>
  e_title("Cumulative number of CRAN downloads")
```


